Dear prado team,

I'm applying for the Digital Marketer role. Your focus on invisible home technology and rapid global growth caught my attention, and I'd love to contribute to your performance marketing efforts.

At Episto, I manage on-page SEO, keyword research, and content for client websites, and I build and maintain WordPress sites. I also track performance using Google Analytics, Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Google Ads. On my own project, mirook.com, I implemented structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. I'm comfortable with data analysis and A/B testing, and I'm eager to deepen my hands-on experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads, and TikTok Ads.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, close to Ghent, and available for hybrid work. I speak English professionally and am improving my Dutch (B1). I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can support prado's growth.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear prado team,

I'm excited to apply for the Digital Marketer position at prado. Your award-winning invisible home technology and rapid international expansion are exactly the kind of environment where I want to grow my performance marketing skills. The chance to work across multiple brands and channels, from paid advertising to influencer collaborations, aligns perfectly with my ambition to become a well-rounded digital marketer.

At Episto, I own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, and I build and maintain WordPress sites. I track performance using Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Google Ads to guide content and SEO decisions. This analytical approach has taught me to spot opportunities and improve results step by step. On my own project, mirook.com, I implemented structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits, measurably raising the site's search-health score. I also integrated social media and ran A/B tests on content and structure.

While my direct experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads, and TikTok Ads is still growing, I have a solid foundation in conversion tracking, data analytics, and A/B testing. I'm a quick learner, proactive, and comfortable in fast-paced settings. I'm eager to apply my skills to prado's e-commerce and brand campaigns, and to learn from your team of ten marketing professionals.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, close to Ghent, and available for hybrid work. I speak English professionally and am improving my Dutch (B1). I'd love to discuss how I can contribute to prado's growth story.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
